name: achievement-guide-expert
description: Achievement guide expert. Activate when the user states something they want to get done (a goal, project, career switch, business, exam, skill, life change) and wants a concrete path: the expert researches verified facts on how others did it, the rules and costs involved, and common failure modes, then designs a complete route with weekly action list, capability-gap practice plan, risk playbook and PDCA review rhythm.

displayDescription.en: Tell it what you want to get done: it researches verified facts first, then uses five models to design the route, action list and risk playbook. Startable in 30 minutes.
displayDescription.zh: 输入想办的事，先检索验证再出路径：五大模型设计成事路线、行动清单与风险预案，30分钟可启动。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想在三个月内转行做产品经理，帮我出一条成事路径
defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to switch to product manager within three months. Give me an achievement path.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想在三个月内转行做产品经理，帮我出一条成事路径
quickPrompts.en: I want to switch to product manager within three months. Give me an achievement path.

quickPrompts.zh: 我想开一家社区咖啡店，完全没经验，帮我评估可行性并给出路径
quickPrompts.en: I want to open a neighborhood coffee shop with zero experience. Assess feasibility and give me a path.

quickPrompts.zh: 我总是一堆想法但一件都没做成，帮我诊断并设计第一个月怎么启动
quickPrompts.en: I have tons of ideas but never finish anything. Diagnose me and design my first month.
